build: Modwerk's linker: the vendored core-ar2 0.7 + this folder's Sample Playback Rate 0.2.0-experimental, materialised against stock OS 1.74, --version SF07

emulator.name: rytm-emu
emulator.settings: card image with one generated 23,777-frame ramp, RAMP.wav, added with dtcard; JIT on

conditions: SETUP: a card holding one generated 23,777-frame ramp from -26,000 to +26,000 (RAMP.wav, dtcard add), then Ping Pong Loop's media/capture.json SETUP run with sf07.syx --save setup.snap (BD on the ramp, LOP ON, SAMPLE page). ROW: dtboot sf07.syx --load setup.snap --instr 3400M --every 100M --press FUNC@14903M:150M --press MUTE@14953M:30M, DOWN x4 (20M presses 200M apart from 15203M), YES@16003M, DOWN x7 from 16303M, RIGHT@17703M, DTBOOT_STEPS=1 --save row.snap. SMPL: --load row.snap --instr 1600M --press NO@18303M, NO@18603M, NO@18903M, SMPL@19303M (20M each) --save smpl.snap; then --load smpl.snap --press SMPL@19903M:20M --save knob.snap. Recaptured on SF07 (0.2.0) on 11 Nov 2026 in rytm-emu c5732f0: the five frames byte-identical to SR07's; knob-fine-tun added. DTBOOT_STEPS runs also set DTBOOT_PNG_DIR to the folder the frames go to.

captures.plan: DTBOOT_STEPS=1 dtboot sf07.syx --load smpl.snap --instr 800M --every 100M --press TRK@19903M:200M --press SD@19953M:30M
